answer: Keep the module as KICD 1.3 and keep the four-level rubric (Exceeds, Meets, Approaches, Below Expectations), which is already used. The cell-size estimate already sits in Lesson 6 and in FE Section 2(f), so no new lesson is needed. The Lesson 7 cheek swab is the remaining KICD conflict: make a prepared slide or photomicrograph of animal cells the default and keep the swab only as an optional extra if the school allows it. Edits below fix Lesson 7 and carry the change through its summary table and the FE.
alternative: Keep the cheek swab as the default with a signed parental or school consent step, and offer the prepared slide only to learners who opt out.
knock_on: Lesson 8 and the FE Section 2 exemplar refer to 'your own cheek cells'; change them to 'the cheek cells you observed' if the swab is dropped. Lesson 9 and Lesson 12 need no change.
